data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 琴键凝止的雪色恋曲
data.action: 怀抱木吉他坐在琴凳上，微低下头拨弄着琴弦，柔顺长发滑落遮住侧颊，眼神带着深切的依恋与患得患失的柔情。
data.location: 峰城大附属音乐教室角落，钢琴旁整齐叠放着未完成的五线谱
data.lighting: 窗外白雪反射的清冷微光与室内走廊投进的微暖泛光交织，形成透明冷艳的空气感
data.camera: side view, eye level, medium shot
data.mood: 经典白学冬日恋曲的深情与哀愁，纯粹至极的依恋
data.description: 峰城大附属音乐教室角落，钢琴旁整齐叠放着未完成的五线谱。怀抱木吉他坐在琴凳上，微低下头拨弄着琴弦，柔顺长发滑落遮住侧颊，眼神带着深切的依恋与患得患失的柔情。 她微微抬眸轻语——“春希君……明明约定好了不再贪心的，可是每当我换上这件睡衣看着你，就又想把整颗心都交给你了。”
data.promptProse: Seated on a wooden piano bench in a quiet music room on a snowy winter night, Setsuna Ogiso wears a pure snow-white fine-knit ankle-length slip dress accented with a soft pom-pom ribbon bow at the chest. Cradling an acoustic guitar in her lap with tender, wistful eyes as snow drifts past the tall windows, she softly plucks the strings beside stacked sheet music.
data.animaCaption: Seated on the piano bench cradling an acoustic guitar in a snow-white fine-knit slip dress tied with a tiny pom-pom bow, she looks down gently as her fingers rest across the strings. Cool light reflected off falling snow outside blends with faint warm hall glow beside the grand piano.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a pure snow-white fine-knit ankle-length slip dress tied with a soft white pom-pom ribbon bow at the neckline.
